sources.author: Hatena Bookmark native ad filter
patch_list: Block ads in in-app article browser
Block list-based ad subrequests and hide safe ad containers in the article WebView.
Clone Hatena Bookmark for safe side-by-side testing
Use a separate package name and provider authorities. Keeps the original installed app untouched; Play license checks may still prevent launch.
Customize the Hoshiori navigation drawer
Reorder or hide existing drawer items; the settings item always remains visible.
Hide native PR entries from article feeds
Exclude PR entries even for logged-out or no-mute hot feeds; keep ordinary articles and existing mute behavior.
Hide weekly bookmark ranking announcement
Hide only weekly bookmark ranking announcements while preserving other announcements.
Hoshiori in-app settings
Add a Hoshiori entry to the original settings and store app toggles locally.
Hoshiori settings Activity registration
Register the private in-app settings screen used by Hoshiori.
Open article from bookmark card
Tap the article card in bookmark details to open the article in the in-app browser.
PR article tab
Optionally show received PR articles in a separate home tab.
Preserve article WebView cookies and storage
Optionally retain website preferences after closing articles and restarting the app; affects all article sites.
